name: remote-sc-description
author: TrustedSec
comment: Change the description of a service on a local or remote machine

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: Target machine. Empty string for local machine

parameters.name: service-name
parameters.description: Name of the service to modify

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: New description text for the service

name: remote-process-destroy
author: TrustedSec
comment: Crash a process by closing its handles via NtDuplicateObject

parameters.name: pid
parameters.description: Process ID to target

parameters.name: handle-id
parameters.description: Specific handle ID to close. Omit or 0 to close all handles

name: remote-sc-start
author: TrustedSec
comment: Start a service on a local or remote machine

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: Target machine. Empty string for local machine

parameters.name: service-name
parameters.description: Name of the service to start

name: remote-schtasks-delete
author: TrustedSec
comment: Delete a scheduled task or task folder

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: Target machine. Empty string for local machine

parameters.name: taskpath
parameters.description: Full path to the task or folder to delete (e.g., \Folder\MyTask)

parameters.name: is-folder
parameters.description: Delete a folder instead of a task: 0=task, 1=folder

name: remote-sc-create
author: TrustedSec
comment: Create a new service on a local or remote machine

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: Target machine. Empty string for local machine

parameters.name: service-name
parameters.description: Internal name of the service to create

parameters.name: binpath
parameters.description: Binary path for the service executable

parameters.name: display-name
parameters.description: Display name for the service

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Service description text

parameters.name: error-mode
parameters.description: Error mode: 0=ignore, 1=normal, 2=severe, 3=critical

parameters.name: start-mode
parameters.description: Start mode: 2=auto, 3=demand, 4=disabled

parameters.name: service-type
parameters.description: Service type: 1=FILE_SYSTEM_DRIVER, 2=KERNEL_DRIVER, 16=WIN32_OWN_PROCESS, 32=WIN32_SHARE_PROCESS

name: remote-process-list-handles
author: TrustedSec
comment: List the open handles of a process

parameters.name: pid
parameters.description: Process ID to list handles for

name: remote-sc-stop
author: TrustedSec
comment: Stop a service on a local or remote machine

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: Target machine. Empty string for local machine

parameters.name: service-name
parameters.description: Name of the service to stop

name: remote-disableuser
author: TrustedSec
comment: Disable a local or remote user account

parameters.name: server
parameters.description: Target machine. Empty string for local machine

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: User account to disable

name: remote-get_priv
author: TrustedSec
comment: Activate a token privilege on the current process or thread

parameters.name: privilege
parameters.description: Privilege name to enable (e.g., SeDebugPrivilege). Prefix with ~ to apply to thread token instead of process token

name: remote-adcs_request_on_behalf
author: TrustedSec
comment: Request an enrollment certificate on behalf of another user

parameters.name: template
parameters.description: Certificate template to request on behalf of the target user

parameters.name: requester
parameters.description: Domain\username to request the certificate on behalf of (e.g., EXAMPLE\Administrator)

parameters.name: download-name
parameters.description: Filename for the downloaded PFX (e.g., Admin.pfx)

parameters.name: enrollment-cert
parameters.description: Path to enrollment agent PFX file with OID_ENROLLMENT_AGENT extension

name: remote-make_token_cert
author: TrustedSec
comment: Create an impersonation token from a certificate PFX file

parameters.name: pfx
parameters.description: Path to PFX certificate file

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password to decrypt the PFX. Omit if no password

name: remote-adduser
author: TrustedSec
comment: Add a new user to a local or remote machine

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Name of the new user account

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password for the new user account

parameters.name: server
parameters.description: Target machine. Omit for local machine

name: remote-reg-delete
author: TrustedSec
comment: Delete a registry key or value

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: Target machine. Empty string for local machine

parameters.name: hive
parameters.description: Registry hive: 0=HKCR, 1=HKCU, 2=HKLM, 3=HKU

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Registry key path

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value name to delete. Empty string when deleting an entire key

parameters.name: delete-key
parameters.description: Set to 1 to delete the entire key instead of a value: 0=no, 1=yes

name: remote-ask-mfa
author: TrustedSec
comment: Display a fake Microsoft Authenticator MFA approval dialog

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: MFA number to display (0-99)

name: remote-suspendresume
author: TrustedSec
comment: Suspend or resume all threads in a process

parameters.name: option
parameters.description: Action to perform: 0=resume, 1=suspend

parameters.name: pid
parameters.description: Process ID to suspend or resume

name: remote-adcs-request
author: TrustedSec
comment: Request an enrollment certificate from an AD certificate authority

parameters.name: ca
parameters.description: Certificate authority to request from (e.g., cert.example.org\example-CERT-CA)

parameters.name: template
parameters.description: Certificate template to request. Empty string for default (User/Machine)

parameters.name: subject
parameters.description: Subject distinguished name (e.g., CN=Administrator,CN=Users,DC=example,DC=org). Empty for current user/machine

parameters.name: alt-name
parameters.description: Alternative subject distinguished name. Empty to omit

parameters.name: alt-url
parameters.description: SAN URL entry, can specify alternate subject SID (e.g., tag:microsoft.com,2022-09-14:sid:S-1-5-21-...). Empty to omit

parameters.name: install
parameters.description: Install certificate in current context: 0 = no, 1 = yes

parameters.name: machine
parameters.description: Request machine certificate instead of user: 0 = no, 1 = yes

parameters.name: app-policy
parameters.description: Add app policy for client auth and certificate agent (ESC15): 0 = no, 1 = yes

parameters.name: dns
parameters.description: Treat alt-name as DNS name instead of UPN: 0 = no, 1 = yes

name: remote-sc-delete
author: TrustedSec
comment: Delete a service from a local or remote machine

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: Target machine. Empty string for local machine

parameters.name: service-name
parameters.description: Name of the service to delete

name: remote-schtasksrun

parameters.name: taskpath
parameters.description: Full path to the task to stop

name: remote-reg-set
author: TrustedSec
comment: Set a registry value on a local or remote machine

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: Target machine. Empty string for local machine

parameters.name: hive
parameters.description: Registry hive: 0=HKCR, 1=HKCU, 2=HKLM, 3=HKU

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Registry key path

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value name to set

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Registry value type: 1=REG_SZ, 2=REG_EXPAND_SZ, 3=REG_BINARY, 4=REG_DWORD, 7=REG_MULTI_SZ, 11=REG_QWORD

name: remote-sc-config

parameters.description: Target machine. Empty string for local machine

parameters.name: service-name
parameters.description: Name of the service to configure

parameters.name: binpath
parameters.description: New binary path for the service

parameters.name: error-mode
parameters.description: Error mode: 0=ignore, 1=normal, 2=severe, 3=critical

parameters.name: start-mode
parameters.description: Start mode: 2=auto, 3=demand, 4=disabled

name: remote-shspawnas

parameters.description: Domain or computer name for the user account

parameters.name: password

parameters.name: shellcode

name: remote-enable-user
author: TrustedSec
comment: Unlock and enable a local or remote user account

parameters.name: server
parameters.description: Target machine or DC for domain accounts. Empty string for local machine

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: User account to unlock and enable

name: remote-shutdown
author: TrustedSec
comment: Shutdown or reboot a local or remote machine

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: Target machine. Empty string for local machine

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: Message to display before shutdown. Empty string for no message

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Seconds to wait before shutdown

parameters.name: close-apps
parameters.description: Force close applications: 0=no, 1=yes

parameters.name: reboot

name: remote-addusertogroup
author: TrustedSec
comment: Add a user to a domain group

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Domain for the user account. Use empty string for local account

parameters.name: server
parameters.description: Target computer to perform the addition on. Use empty string for local machine

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: User to add to the group

parameters.name: groupname
parameters.description: Group to add the user to

name: remote-get-azure-token
author: TrustedSec
comment: Perform an OAuth code grant against Azure and print the returned tokens

parameters.name: client-id
parameters.description: Azure app client ID (must have consent and http://localhost redirect URI)

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: OAuth scope string for the client ID

parameters.name: browser
parameters.description: Browser to use: 0=Edge, 1=Chrome, 2=Default, 3=Other

parameters.name: hint
parameters.description: Login hint email address. Omit if only one saved login exists

parameters.name: browser-path
parameters.description: Full path to browser executable (only used when browser=3/Other, max 260 chars)

name: remote-reg-save
author: TrustedSec
comment: Save a registry hive to a file on disk

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Registry key path to save from

parameters.name: output-path
parameters.description: File path on target to write the backup to

parameters.name: hive
parameters.description: Registry hive: 0=HKCR, 1=HKCU, 2=HKLM, 3=HKU

name: remote-sc_failure
author: TrustedSec
comment: Configure failure recovery actions for a service

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: Target machine. Empty string for local machine

parameters.name: service-name
parameters.description: Name of the service to configure

parameters.name: reset-period
parameters.description: Length of period with no failures before resetting the failure count (in seconds)

parameters.name: reboot-msg
parameters.description: Broadcast message before reboot on failure. Empty string to omit

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: Command to run on failure. Empty string to omit

parameters.name: num-actions
parameters.description: Number of failure actions to configure

parameters.name: actions
parameters.description: Comma-separated action/delay pairs (e.g., restart/5000,reboot/30000). Actions: none, restart, reboot, run
